description: During the recent League of Women Voters candidate forum, I was asked a question I didn't have an answer to: “Should the public school system’s vaccine mandates be updated to match the new federal vaccine guidelines?” Now? Now, I have an answer.

title: Federal Vaccine Guidelines Changed. Should Wisconsin Change Too?
